svg.title: Installs
svg.desc: Installs of jdx's tools through mise in the 30 days to Oct 3, CI excluded: mr boxington 3,302 (new), hk 60,563 (50% month over month), pitchfork 14,877 (24% month over month), fnox 42,974 (16% month over month), usage 52,798 (-1% month over month), aube 12,013 (-5% month over month). jdx tools combined 20% month over month, all of mise 16%.

g.text: installs through mise · 30 days to Oct 3 · CI excluded
jdx tools +20% · all of mise +16% MoM
counted once per IP, tool, version and day, so these are installs, not unique users. aube also ships inside mise's npm backend
and through npm and Homebrew, which isn't counted here.
